name: Time-Based Condition
description: A condition plugin that gates visibility by time (schedule/date range).
project_description:
The Time-Based Condition module provides a flexible solution for displaying content based on specific time frames. This module is perfect for users new to Drupal who want to control the visibility of blocks or other content types based on dates and times. By leveraging Drupal's caching system, it ensures optimal performance while dynamically showing or hiding content according to predefined schedules. This module is ideal for time-sensitive content like promotions, events, or seasonal messages.

 Time-Based Condition works internally via the Drupal\Component\Datetime\TimeInterface , which uses the servers time.
